caption: The start button on a blender is pressed, and the blades spin and the contents whirl.

sa.check: A blender with contents in its jug.
The blades and contents are still before the press.
The order is still, press, spinning and whirling.

pc.expect: The blades start to spin and the contents start to move at the moment the button is pressed, and only then.
pc.fail: The button is pressed and the blades stay still to the end of the clip; or the contents whirl before the press; or the blades spin while the contents stay still; or the contents whirl while the blades are still.

pc.expect: Before the press nothing in the jug moves; afterwards the blender runs steadily and does not stop, start or reverse on its own.
pc.fail: The blades stop and restart with the button untouched; or the contents swirl before the button is touched; or the blades reverse direction; or the jug spins round with the blades.

pc.expect: The contents swirl round the jug in the direction of the blades, climbing the walls and dipping at the centre.
pc.fail: The contents rise straight up as a column; or swirl against the blades' direction; or stay flat and still at the surface while the blades spin below; or the contents leap out of a closed jug.

pc.expect: The contents flow as liquid or soft food; the jug stays rigid and the blades stay stiff.
pc.fail: The contents move as a solid block; or the jug wobbles or bulges; or the blades bend or flop like rubber.

pc.expect: One blender with one jug; the contents stay inside the jug; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The contents pass through the jug's walls; or the jug vanishes or duplicates; or the finger passes into the base; or the contents change into something else or vanish.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The blender's colour, the jug and the counter stay the same; the contents change only by mixing.
pc.fail: The blender changes colour; or the jug changes shape; or the counter's contents rearrange.

note: The contents turning smoother or changing colour as they blend is the expected result and is not judged.
